CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR  ---------

For the Petitioner/Applicant: Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Advocate Ms Priyanka Agrawal, Advocate For the State: Mr. Shailesh Kumar Sinha, A.P.P.
---------
04/Dated: 16.01.2024 1.
Heard the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Ratu P.S. Case No. 420 of 2022, registered for the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471, 420, 272, 273, 336 & 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code, Section 47(A)
of the Excise Act and Section 55 & 52 of the Excise Amendment Act, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
3.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant is a medical representative and he has already responded to the notice under Section 41(A) of the Cr.P.C.
The only allegation against this applicant is that the motorcycle of the applicant has been found at the place of occurrence.
It has been explained that at that time it was in possession of one of the co-accused namely, Ankit Gupta, who is cousin brother of this applicant.
The applicant has not been apprehended at the spot.
The applicant is neither named in the F.I.R. nor there any material to suggest that the applicant has played any role in the commission of crime.
On the above basis, prayer for anticipatory bail has been made.
4. On the other hand, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the applicant.

5. Considering the above facts and the fact that the applicant has responded to the notice under Section 41(A) of the Cr.P.C., I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi in connection with Ratu P.S. Case No.420 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure and also on the condition that the applicant will co-operating with the investigating agency.

Further,
this applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
(Rajesh Kumar, J.)
